# statusdrift_status_page_announcements (Data Source)

Fetches all announcements for a status page.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_id` (Number) The ID of the status page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `status_page_announcements` (Attributes List) List of status page announcements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_page_announcements))

<a id="nestedatt--status_page_announcements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_page_announcements`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the announcement is enabled.
- `ends_at` (String) When the announcement ends.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the announcement.
- `starts_at` (String) When the announcement starts.
- `title` (String) The title of the announcement.
- `type` (String) The type of the announcement.
